items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: She had been married to Joe Eady, who was a popular nightclub operator on the South Side of Chicago in those days.

ctx.x: This is January 4th, 1980, and we're continuing this from last night. You've been busy, you're getting ready to move out of Boston here, and I thought we'd just talk about something we said last night, have a little rundown because I'm sure people would be interested in knowing part of your genealogy, your family and whatnot. You mentioned your first marriage to Irene, and there were no children involved. And would you like to take it on from there, and the years and whatnot?

Yeah, I believe Irene and I got married -- her full name was Irene Armstrong. She had been married to Joe Eady, who was a popular nightclub operator on the South Side of Chicago in those days. And I guess Irene and I stayed together until maybe 1937 and we separated and finally divorced. And Irene, I guess during the '40s, married a man out in Cleveland. (Kitchings)
And then in 1945 I married Janice Karate (PHONETIC) from New York City, she was born and raised in New York City.
